name: How long does a finish carpentry project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a finish carpentry project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a finish carpentry project depends heavily on its size and complexity. A small project, such as adding baseboards to a single room, might take a day or two. A larger project, like installing custom built-ins across multiple rooms or extensive trim work throughout a whole house, could take several weeks. Factors like material availability and drying times for finishes can also influence the timeline. During our initial consultation, we provide a projected timeline tailored to your specific project, considering all necessary steps from material selection to final installation and cleanup.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by size and complexity; a single room's baseboards might take days, while whole-home trim or custom built-ins could take weeks. We provide a tailored timeline during consultation.
